content_sections.heading: MANUU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MANUU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download MANUU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Caretaker (Female): Graduate from a recognised University / Institute; Proficiency in Computer Operations; Knowledge of Urdu; Two (02) years experience in managing Hostel / Canteen / Guest House related affairs. Cook (Male/Female): 10th Pass from a recognized Board; Knowledge of Urdu; Two (02) years experience in cooking in the Kitchen of Hostel / Canteen / Guest House. Helper (Male/Female): 10th Pass from a recognized Board; Knowledge of Urdu; Preference will be given to the candidates having experience in maintenance and cleanliness of Hostels / Canteens or any other large eating-houses.

content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.text: Caretaker, Cook, Helper: Maximum age 32 years

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Registration at University Guest House by 9.30 am on the day of interview Walk-in-Interview

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) is conducting this recruitment for various short-term contractual positions in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Caretaker (Female), Cook (Male/Female), and Helper (Male/Female) across 14 total vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly to the venue on the scheduled date with required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 7 October 2026 at the designated university premises in Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Caretaker and Cook positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Caretaker (Female) and Cook (Male/Female) posts will receive a consolidated salary of ₹25,200/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Helper position?
faq.answer: Candidates selected for the Helper (Male/Female) post will receive a monthly salary of ₹20,675/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Helper post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Helper position must have passed the 10th standard from a recognized Board and possess knowledge of the Urdu language.

faq.question: Q8. Is prior experience required for the Caretaker post?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants for Caretaker (Female) need to be Graduates with proficiency in computers, knowledge of Urdu, and two years of experience managing hostel, canteen, or guest house affairs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the upper age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Caretaker, Cook, and Helper posts is preferably below 32 years of age.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates report on the day of the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report for registration by 9:30 AM at the University Guest House, Maulana Azad National Urdu University, Hyderabad.
